name: Ninetears
english_description: A Spanish-language LPMud, also known as Driade / FFICMUD, run by "Alex" ("Tyrael") in the early 2000s, built on a Final Realms mudlib base with substantial custom changes. A real, substantial multi-year archive with dozens of wizard-built home areas and a large domain tree covering Urghak, Faeleen, Keroon, Asgard, Ishtar, Serkesh, and more, alongside several guild systems including trolls, khurgars, chaos barbarians, and jade knights. New characters register (name confirmation, password, gender) and are born into "Plano Inmaterial" (the Immaterial Plane), a soul-formation antechamber room framing character creation as a literal act of spiritual birth before the soul enters the physical world. Player and staff rank in this world carries its own in-game titling lineage -- ordinary mortals, then ascending ranks named after demigods (semidioses), lords, thanes, patrons, regents, and finally the gods (dioses) themselves. The archive also ships an in-game FTP-like file-transfer feature via a listening network service.
